request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and clear, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, light percussion, reflective and gentle mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mikloth fathered Shimeah
Living opposite their kin
In the city of Jerusalem
With relatives nearby then

[Chorus]
Lived near their kinsmen
In the holy city
With their relatives
In the land

[Verse]
Jeiel lived in Gibeon
Wife Maacah by his side
Abdon was the firstborn son
Zur and Kish in that line

[Chorus]
Lived near their kinsmen
In the holy city
With their relatives
In the land

[Bridge]
Ner fathered Kish the king
Saul was born of that line
Jonathan and Malchishua
Abinadab and Eshbaal

[Outro]
Mikloth was the father
Of Shimeam in the genealogy
